video_title: The Haunted House (1981 Disney Fisher-Price Read-Along)
description:
The rare & now hard to find Fisher-Price Read-Along storybook & cassette tape, released in 1981. Featuring the voices of Hal Smith as our narrator, Peter Renaday as Mickey Mouse and Clarence Nash as Donald Duck (Clarence was the original & most prominent voice of the character). Enjoy!

This book & tape has been out of print for decades and is being uploaded strictly for preservation, educational, & archival purposes as a result. Enjoy! author: Fisher-Price
video_title: Mickey Mouse and Friends - Double Birthday Surprise (1985 Disney Fisher-Price) (Story Side)
description:
Rare, long out of print 1985 book & tape by Fisher-Price called Mickey Mouse & Friends - Double Birthday Surprise. This was both a read-along story & activity book. Features Hal Smith as the narrator while Peter Renaday is Mickey, Patricia Parris is Minnie Mouse, Tony Pope is Goofy, Jim Tadevic is Donald, and (I believe) Keith Mitchell (Young Tod in Fox & the Hound) as Mortie & Ferdie in this. Enjoy this fun little gem of a story.

This book & tape has been out of print for decades and is being uploaded strictly for preservation, educational, & archival purposes as a result. Enjoy!
